The forest has expanded immensely since its creation and is now capable of supporting a large population.

My [Hellite Champion](http://orig10.deviantart.net/5468/f/2012/151/6/7/lolth___queen_of_spiders__by_anfedart-d51t84h.jpg), who has adopted the name of Dionaea, lived with me in the Forest of Eternal Life for a time, learning about the land and the plants. We took strolls through the Forest of Brotherhood and I had her live among the Thorac Humans and my Säen. Although it is obvious that brotherhood, community, and love for the Green does not come naturally to this creature, we reached a point where I believed that she was ready to be my Champion. Dionaea is an ambitious creature who knows that if she serves me well, I may make her a demi god who will live eternal with me in the Forest of Eternal Life.

When the time was right and the environmental conditions set by Xathrius, God of Necromancy, could be met, I took Dionaea and the mindless Thorac child whose village had been attacked by The Lythe, deep into the Forest of Brotherhood. It was here that Dionaea sacrificed this poor creature in a ritual to Xathrius. She has since walked the Forest of Brotherhood at nights, practicing her necromancy on the decaying bodies of the Säen, praying to Xathrius.

Being around this creature has been strange for me, as she could not be more different than my beautiful creations. Yesterday I walked through a market in the main village of the Säen in the Forest of Brotherhood. Those individuals who had returned from The Roost had brought with them a wonderfully fast growing vine which they have fashioned into [housing for the Thorac Humans](http://ultraimg.com/images/image05334.jpg), trellises for their gardens, hammocks, fences, but more important they brought with them ideas. Amazed by the airborne dwellings, the Saen have begun building[ dwellings high in the oldest trees of the forest](http://static.tvtropes.org/pmwiki/pub/images/Ender_Resized.jpeg), hidden, for the Thorac humans to flee to in the event of another Lythe attack.

Now they meet at the Market in the center of their main village trading carved wooden beads, baskets woven from snagweed and other grasses, woven fabrics from plant fibers, dyes, and other goods. Their rudimentary plant-fiber bags now depict images of flowers and leafs. I am very impressed with their advancements. However, as expected, while they are busy creating crafts and products from the various plantlife they grow, not one has thought to create some kind of weapon, even with the always impending threat of The Lythe and other malicious creatures on this planet.

And so now my gargantuan Säen patrol the forest, and my Hellite Dionaea walks the nights practicing [raising her dead](http://www.dragonarmyone.com/_/rsrc/1412926872472/Home/ilysador-campaign-setting-1/bestiary/vile-plant-template/61043740014d865a9ddb3686c6a904b7.jpg?height=400&width=323), The Thorac Humans and the Saen have adapted to this very well, trusting that they are under no threat from their deceased.

One of my favorite Säen is currently at the Tree of Life. I sent Diospyra there to assist the Flora with the Naga fruit. She has done great things but now she, along with the Flora and the Tree itself, have been separated from the rest of the mortal world. Other strange things have been happening as well. Some of the more pious Säen have asked me many times in their prayers to help an individual named Red Fir; he was once an esteemed member of the community who contributed many new species of fruit tree to the forest, but has lately been suffering mood swings and violent fits. Violence is a trait which does not come natural to the Säen and I worry what new ailment or curse this might be. He has been temporarily confined to a remote area of the forest to do his work, but if his rage continues I do not know what I will do with him.

Now that the Saen have adopted the culture of bartering, I would like to invite the other peaceful creatures of Gaea to The Forest of Brotherhood. There is abundant food and housing, and it is relatively safe all things considered. I believe that the Community Market in the forest will thrive with the help of the other Gaeans, and the Saen will need input and ideas from other races to continue their advancement.
